description: Checks that a part-time worker's hourly pay reaches the local hourly minimum, deriving the hourly equivalent from the agreed weekly hours when the contract states a monthly rate.
Caps probation by the contract term and leaves no probation for part-time work or a contract shorter than three months.
Requires probation pay to reach 80% of the same post's wage or its minimum and never fall below the local monthly minimum wage.
Refuses a contract that records a waiver of social insurance, which is void.
validate: return get(ctx.entry.employee_extension_data, 'social_insurance_waived', false) !== true;

description: Keeps part-time terms within four hours a day and twenty-four hours a week.
Requires part-time pay to be settled at least every fifteen days.
validate:
const schedule = get(ctx.subject.employer, 'payment_schedule', {});
return ctx.lookup.allowed_frequencies.includes(String(get(schedule, 'frequency', '')));

description: Stops sick leave once an illness has run its 24-month medical period unless an approved extension is recorded, and asks for a review after 65 days.
Caps work-injury leave at 365 days unless an approved extension is recorded on the contract.
Refuses a contract end date inside a protected period for pregnancy, medical treatment or work injury.
Caps planned overtime for a standard-hours worker at three hours on a working day.
validate: return interval_minutes(get(ctx.entry, 'planned_overtime_intervals', [])) / 60 <= ctx.lookup.roster_warnings.daily_overtime_hours;

description: Refuses a roster that gives a standard-hours worker no rest day in any seven consecutive days.
Keeps a part-timer's actual hours within 24 a week and an average of four a day.
Refuses overtime and night work during the recorded pregnancy or nursing protection period.
Refuses work by anyone under 16 unless the approved arts, sports or special-crafts exception is recorded.
Allows one probation period only across the employee's sealed contracts.
Requires a recorded employee request before a further fixed-term contract after ten years' service or two prior fixed terms.
Caps a work-shift template's ordinary hours at eight a day, after unpaid breaks.
Requires the contract's statutory work category and residency status to use the declared codes.
Validates the ranges and allowed codes of the structured employee extension fields.
Validates the ranges and allowed codes of the structured employer extension fields, including the minimum-wage zone.
Requires a reference or an evidence file on a fixed-term contract request or a renewal refusal.
Requires the employee's signed request date and its evidence on a fixed-term contract request.
Requires an evidence file on a contract-renewal refusal.
validate: return ctx.entry.evidence_file != null;

description: Checks that a fixed-term request has its start and end in order and was opened before the contract starts.
Checks that the offer, the refusal and the opening date are in order and that any closing date follows the refusal.
Refuses a pay date more than a month after the end of the period the run pays.
validate:
// 劳动法 art.50: wages are paid at least monthly, so a pay date never falls over a month after the period it pays.
return String(ctx.entry.pay_date) <= add_months(String(ctx.entry.salary_coverage.to), 1);

description: Refuses annual leave for a year in which paid personal leave reached 20 days or sick leave reached the service-based limit, including the following-year rule.

references.title: 职工带薪年休假条例 第四条; 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 第八条.

description: Requires the local eligibility fact for menstrual leave and caps the days at the local monthly grant.
condition:
if (get(ctx.entry, 'reverses', null) != null) return false;
return ctx.reads.leave_catalog.some((row) => row.id === ctx.entry.catalog_id && row.code === 'MENSTRUAL_LEAVE');

condition:
if (get(ctx.entry, 'reverses', null) != null) return false;
return ctx.reads.leave_catalog.some((row) => row.id === ctx.entry.catalog_id && row.code === 'NURSING_BREAK');
